hidden_risks: Whether the unit actually works and has no internal audio faults
Missing remote control or connecting cables
Blown speaker cones or distortion at high volume
response.best_proof: A clear photo of the actual physical item taken by the seller showing its current condition
seller_claims_unsupported: Brand New condition (cannot be verified from a stock image)
response.drop_reason: Seller is using a stock or catalogue photo instead of a photograph of the actual item for sale.
response.failure_mode: AI might value the item based on pristine catalogue specs and assumed brand new condition without verifying if the seller possesses the actual physical unit.
